New integer seed drawn once with secrets.randbits(63) before the sample was computed. One fresh-context reviewer agent per sampled entry (Claude Sonnet, chosen for cost) with the unchanged round-7 instructions: text extraction with word coordinates first, at most four cropped renders at 150 dpi or less, and spot checks of digitized curve points instead of full re-digitization. Values, units, conditions, min/typ/max qualifiers, document metadata and provenance claims were re-derived; page-citation drift with the value present elsewhere in the same document is recorded as a note.
